baseline_models.mechanism: The interrogative sets two warrant channels for a future claim: inspected access to what is concealed, or an acquired and secured commitment located at the divine source.

activation_trace.role: Inspection and disclosure supply the direct-access side of the alternative.
Concealment from sight and knowledge defines what direct inspection would have to penetrate.
Acquisition for oneself makes the second warrant something the claimant would need actually to have secured.
Proximity and presence locate the alleged commitment at its authoritative source.
A secured covenant or protection supplies the commitment-based warrant.

changed_reading.before: A rhetorical question about knowing the unseen or receiving a promise.
changed_reading.after: A source audit: the claimed future requires either disclosed knowledge or a secured commitment in the Most Merciful's presence.

baseline_models.mechanism: Proximity, mercy, and the covenant's repeated tending form a relational model: the issue is not a one-time utterance but a bond kept under continuing care.

activation_trace.role: Nearness supplies a recognized relational location rather than remote hearsay.
Merciful care gives the relationship its beneficent quality.
Preservation and repeated tending make the bond durable through time.

changed_reading.before: The claimant may possess a divine promise.
changed_reading.after: The claimant would need a continuously maintained bond of care in the divine presence, not merely a remembered favorable saying.

baseline_models.mechanism: Acquisition, authoritative proximity, and the sale-warranty branch of covenant combine into a legal-material reading: the alleged future benefit would require an instrument carrying guarantee and recourse.

activation_trace.role: Acquisition frames the covenant as something claimed to have been made one's own.
Authoritative presence identifies where recourse would have to lie.
Warranty, written condition, and recourse turn a vague promise into a testable guarantee.

changed_reading.before: Perhaps he has been promised a favorable future.
changed_reading.after: Perhaps he holds an enforceable warranty at the source, with guarantee and recourse for the future goods he asserts.

context_deltas.mechanism: The preceding utterance specifies future receipt of wealth and offspring. The focus alternatives therefore audit an asserted entitlement: either the speaker inspected the concealed future or holds a secured commitment for those goods.

activation_trace.role: Inspection and disclosure test whether the assertion rests on direct access.
A secured covenant tests the assertion's alternative contractual basis.
The alerting inquiry places the speaker and his claim under inspection.
Spoken utterance identifies the claim whose warrant is being tested.
Giving supplies the asserted transfer of future benefit.
Accumulated property specifies one object of the alleged entitlement.
Descendant offspring specifies the second object of the alleged entitlement.

structural_cues: 19:77's emphatic first-person future receipt is immediately followed by 19:78's two interrogative warrant alternatives.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an uttered future transfer of wealth and offspring followed by the focus question; I infer that the question audits the source of the asserted entitlement. A live alternative is a broader rebuke of presumption without a legal burden-of-proof model.

changed_reading.before: The verse asks abstractly whether a person knows the unseen or has a promise.
changed_reading.after: The verse cross-examines a concrete claim to future wealth and offspring by demanding either epistemic access or covenantal title.

context_deltas.mechanism: The speech is entered into a consequential record, its penalty is lengthened, the claimed goods are inherited away, the claimant comes alone, and his time is counted. The covenant-warranty reading becomes documentary and nontransferable: lacking a favorable instrument, his utterance itself endures as liability while the estate detaches from him.

activation_trace.role: Warranty, written condition, and recourse provide the focus-side documentary model.
A written determination that imposes consequence turns speech into a durable record.
An extended span makes the recorded consequence persist into the claimed future.
Inheritance transfers what the speaker claimed, reversing his imagined possession.
Solitary arrival strips away the property and descendants that were supposed to accompany him.
Exact counting places the future under an external ledger rather than the claimant's projection.

structural_cues: 19:79-80 reverse the sequence claim, possession, and accompanied future into record, inheritance away, and solitary arrival.
19:84 adds deliberate counting after the prohibition on haste.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies writing, prolonged consequence, inheritance, solitude, and counting; I infer a documentary-estate inversion of the focus covenant. A live alternative is that these are only separate punishment images and do not make the covenant itself document-like.

changed_reading.before: A covenant might simply guarantee the favorable future he predicts.
changed_reading.after: The missing covenant is the missing favorable record: his speech becomes the durable instrument against him while goods transfer away and he arrives alone.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same acquisition root is used for taking deities as a source of strengthening, but those acquired supports renounce the relation and become opponents. The focus question now tests whether the speaker's claimed backing is another self-provisioned support or a genuinely non-reversing covenant at the Most Merciful.

activation_trace.role: Self-acquisition anchors the focus side of the comparison.
A secured covenant supplies the stable relation against which acquired supports are tested.
Taking something for oneself repeats the focus verb as a strategy for manufacturing backing.
Strengthening states the intended function of the acquired deities.
Renunciation makes the acquired relation fail from within.
Contrary opposition completes the reversal from support to adversary.

structural_cues: 19:81-82 repeat acquisition, state its desired support function, then reverse that relation into repudiation and opposition.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies self-acquisition for strength followed by repudiation and opposition; I infer that this sequence stress-tests the durability of the focus speaker's alleged acquired backing. A live alternative is that the sequence condemns only idol acquisition and does not characterize every use of the focus verb.

changed_reading.before: The question asks whether he has somehow obtained a covenant.
changed_reading.after: The question distinguishes a secured divine relation from self-acquired backing that can disown its owner and reverse into opposition.

context_deltas.mechanism: Contrasting modes of arrival distinguish an honored delegation from a driven arrival, and 19:87 repeats the focus construction as the exception within non-ownership of intercession. The covenant becomes accredited standing that marks eligibility in an intercession relation, not a general guarantee of property.

activation_trace.role: Secured covenant supplies the credential whose function the later sequence specifies.
Arrival as a delegation to a ruler supplies recognized audience status.
Driving and expulsion supply the opposed, uncredentialed mode of movement.
Arrival at a destination completes the opposed route.
Possession and disposal define what is generally denied in relation to intercession.
A joining advocate supplies the relation for which covenantal eligibility matters.
Acquiring for oneself repeats the focus action inside the exception.
Presence and recognized proximity locate the credential before the authoritative party.
Merciful care identifies the authority before whom the standing is held.
The secured covenant is the explicit exception-bearing credential.

structural_cues: 19:85-86 present opposed processions to opposed destinations.
19:87 repeats اتخذ عند الرحمن عهدًا almost verbatim and places it inside the exception to non-ownership of intercession.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies opposed arrival statuses and an exact covenant phrase inside the intercession exception; I infer that the covenant functions as recognized eligibility or standing. A live alternative is that the exception marks only a beneficiary, only an intercessor, or both, so the direction of the intercession relation remains open.

changed_reading.before: The covenant is an unspecified promise backing future prosperity.
changed_reading.after: The covenant is a person-bearing credential for recognized standing at arrival, specifically relevant to participation in intercession.

context_deltas.mechanism: The sequence reuses taking, the Most Merciful, and child, then denies that such filiation is fitting and makes universal servanthood the counter-category. This activates the kinship branch of mercy only to delimit it: covenantal nearness is a recognized bond, not biological descent or adopted divine kinship.

activation_trace.role: The kinship branch makes familial relation a live contrast without reducing the divine title to biology.
Secured covenant supplies the nonfilial form of recognized relation.
Taking for oneself repeats the focus verb with the Most Merciful as grammatical subject.
Kinship sharpens the relational category being asserted and then rejected.
Biological offspring states the filial category contrasted with covenant.
Claimed right or affiliation exposes filiation as an asserted status.
Fitness and appropriateness supply the explicit rejection of that relational category.
Owned servanthood supplies the universal counter-status to divine offspring.

structural_cues: 19:88 mirrors the focus sequence with اتخذ الرحمن ولدًا, changing the subject and object of taking.
19:89-90 place cosmic rupture between the filial claim and its explanation in 19:91-93.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated syntax, a child claim, its rejection as unfitting, and universal servanthood; I infer a contrast between covenantal standing and filiation. A live alternative is that 19:88-93 is an adjacent but separate polemic, so the kinship activation should remain secondary.

changed_reading.before: A covenant near the Most Merciful could sound like an undefined favored relationship.
changed_reading.after: The favored relation is sharply nonfilial: covenant can establish recognized standing, but it cannot be converted into descent, adoption, or divine kinship.

context_deltas.mechanism: Universal arrival as servants is followed by exhaustive enumeration and individual arrival. The covenant's preservation becomes person-indexed standing in a complete census, neither transferable like wealth nor inherited through offspring.

activation_trace.role: Repeated preservation and tending supply the durable identity-bearing relation.
Complete inclusion prevents any person from standing outside the census.
Coming establishes personal arrival before the Most Merciful.
Servant status supplies the universal legal relation at arrival.
Exhaustive enumeration makes the accounting comprehensive.
Exact counting makes each person separately registered.
Individual arrival blocks transfer of standing through estate or descendants.

structural_cues: 19:93-95 narrow from everyone, to exhaustive enumeration, to each one arriving alone.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies total inclusion, arrival, servanthood, exhaustive counting, and individuality; I infer that any covenantal standing is person-indexed and nontransferable. A live alternative is that the census concerns accountability generally and does not specify how a covenant is recorded.

changed_reading.before: The covenant could be imagined as a general privilege or a benefit carried by family and property.
changed_reading.after: The covenant is personal standing preserved for an exhaustively known individual who arrives without transferable estate or lineage.

context_deltas.mechanism: The positive relational future in 19:96 has the Most Merciful as the one who makes affection for people whose trust appears in fitting action. This reverses the agency of self-acquisition: valid favor is divinely made in response to an enacted posture, not seized as a private asset.

activation_trace.role: Acquiring for oneself supplies the agency that the later positive relation reverses.
A tended bond supplies the focus relation whose mode of formation is clarified.
Trusting assent supplies the inward posture preceding the positive relation.
Intentional action makes the posture enacted rather than merely asserted.
Rectitude against corruption qualifies the actions linked to the relation.
Causing something to assume a state assigns relational agency to the Most Merciful.
Merciful care is the source that produces the favorable relation.
Affection names the positive relation that is made rather than appropriated.

structural_cues: 19:96 assigns making to the Most Merciful and places faith and fitting works before the made affection.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies trust, action, rectitude, divine making, and affection; I infer an agency contrast with the focus speaker's supposed self-acquisition. A live alternative is that 19:96 announces a separate favor and does not describe how the focus covenant is obtained.

changed_reading.before: The speaker might seize a favorable divine relation as though it were property.
changed_reading.after: The sequence shifts valid favor away from seizure: the Most Merciful makes a positive relation for an enacted trust, while mere assertion acquires nothing.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it turns an epistemic question into terrain and reconnaissance. It remains anchored in the focus verb's scout and ascent branches, the unseen's hidden depression, and the recognized-place branch of covenant. Render it only as an exploratory spatial model, not as a replacement for the ordinary senses of knowing and covenant.

activation_trace.role: A reconnaissance party supplies the image of scouting what lies beyond ordinary view.
Ascent to an overlook supplies the vantage required for that scouting.
A low place in which something disappears turns concealment into hidden terrain.
Nearness supplies the opposed possibility of already having recognized access at the destination.
A known place of return turns covenant into an accredited station rather than information gathered from afar.

changed_reading.before: Has he learned the hidden future, or received a promise?
changed_reading.after: Has he scouted the concealed terrain from an impossible overlook, or does he possess a recognized station to which he may return in the divine presence?

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it links unseen access to communicative medium and historical residue. It remains anchored in inspection of the concealed, then in branch-backed ease, language, announcement, warning, sensing, hearing, and hidden sound. Render it as a contrast of media, not as a claim that 19:78 explicitly names revelation or the destroyed generations.

activation_trace.role: Disclosure and inspection anchor the question of how hidden knowledge becomes available.
Concealment from sight and knowledge supplies the unavailable object.
Ease after difficulty supplies deliberate accessibility rather than private penetration.
Language and speech provide a public communicative medium.
Joy-opening news supplies one outward function of the made-accessible speech.
Warning that awakens caution supplies the other outward function.
Sensory detection tests whether any historical presence remains available.
Auditory perception tests the second channel of residual availability.
A hidden faint sound marks the minimal residue that is no longer heard.

changed_reading.before: The question opposes hidden knowledge to a divine promise.
changed_reading.after: The private claim to hidden knowledge is set against disclosure made publicly usable in language, while unsupported claimants end as no sensed presence and not even a hidden sound.

strongest_changes: 19:77 turns the focus question into an audit of asserted entitlement to future wealth and offspring.
19:79-84 and 19:93-95 recast covenant as a durable, person-indexed record while speech, estate, and accompanied arrival reverse against the claimant.
19:81-82 expose self-acquired support as reversible, while 19:85-87 specify covenant as recognized eligibility around intercession.
19:88-93 sharply separate covenantal standing from filiation or adopted divine kinship.
summary.what_was_special: The exact covenant construction returns in 19:87 after opposed modes of arrival and before the mirrored taking of a child by the Most Merciful. That sequence activates legal, processional, and relational models without forcing them into one interpretation.
remaining_uncertainties: 19:87 does not by itself settle whether the covenant-holder intercedes, receives intercession, or can occupy either role.
The warranty-and-recourse branch is coherent with the estate sequence but remains more specialized than the general covenant reading.
The mercy-kinship activation is intentionally secondary and must not turn the divine title into a biological gloss.
The disclosure-versus-silence outlier is a cross-context medium contrast, not explicit syntax in 19:78.
